winning_hook_formulas: The 'Hidden Loss' Formula: [Warning Emoji] Stop [Action] before you [Negative Outcome/Loss] due to [Specific Hidden Factor].
The 'Financial Reality' Formula: [Alarm Emoji] Why your [Asset/Investment] is secretly [Negative Verb] while you think it is [Positive State].
script_directives: Keep total duration strictly under 22 seconds to maximize loop potential and retention.
Eliminate all fluff; start the narrative immediately after the hook with a single, high-value data point or technical level.
Use a confrontational, 'insider-knowledge' tone that positions the viewer as being 'tricked' by traditional financial institutions.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, search-driven keywords in the first 5 words of the title (e.g., 'Nifty', 'Bank FD', 'Stocks').
Limit hashtags to 3 highly relevant, broad finance tags (e.g., #StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance, #Investing) to avoid algorithm dilution.
